content.content:
We need to create a 7-day travel plan starting March 22 - 28, 2022. Starting in Minneapolis, then three different Texas cities. So we have Minneapolis start day 1, then travel to Texas cities over days 2-7? Probably day 1 in Minneapolis, day 2 travel to Texas city 1 (like Dallas), day 3 in Dallas, day 4 travel to city 2 (Houston), day 5 in Houston, day 6 travel to city 3 (Austin), day 7 in Austin. Or could do different order.

We need to provide for each day: day number, current_city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. Must use function submit_day_plan for each day. Must fill fields. We have budget $11,900 for two people; need to keep cost under that. But the function doesn't need cost, but we may choose reasonable. We should choose family-friendly accommodations in each city.

Cities: Minneapolis, Dallas, Houston, Austin. Use transportation: flights or maybe drives. From Minneapolis to Dallas flight, from Dallas to Houston flight, from Houston to Austin flight. Provide flight details like Flight Number etc. We can make up plausible times.

Breakfast: maybe local cafe. Attraction: museums, parks. Lunch/dinner: child-friendly restaurants.

Accommodation: name of hotel or Airbnb. We need 3 different Texas cities: Dallas, Houston, Austin. That fits.

We need to call submit_day_plan once per day, days 1-7.

Let's craft.

Day 1: Minneapolis. Transportation: "Stay in Minneapolis". Breakfast: "Brunch at The Bachelor Farmer". Attraction: "Minnesota Zoo, Minneapolis;". Lunch: "Taco Bell? No, maybe "The Brook". Dinner: "Spoon & Clay". Accommodation: "Hotel 29 Minneapolis".

Day 2: Travel from Minneapolis to Dallas. Transportation: "Flight Number: DL123, from Minneapolis to Dallas, Departure Time: 08:00, Arrival Time: 11:00". Breakfast: "Before flight: Grab coffee at Starbucks". Attraction: "Dallas World Aquarium, Dallas;". Lunch: "Pecan Street Market". Dinner: "Pappadeaux Seafood Kitchen". Accommodation: "Hyatt Regency Dallas".

Day 3: Dallas day. Transportation: "Car rental". Breakfast: "Café 44". Attraction: "Perot Museum of Nature and Science, Dallas;". Lunch: "The Rustic". Dinner: "Uchi Dallas". Accommodation: same.

Day 4: Travel Dallas to Houston. Flight: "Flight Number: AA456, from Dallas to Houston, Departure Time: 09:00, Arrival Time: 10:30". Breakfast: "On the plane". Attraction: "Space Center Houston, Houston;". Lunch: "The Breakfast Klub". Dinner: "Pappas Seafood". Accommodation: "Hilton Anatole". Day 5: Houston. Transportation: car rental. Breakfast: "Common Grounds". Attraction: "Houston Zoo, Houston;". Lunch: "Alamo Drafthouse". Dinner: "The Grove". Accommodation same.

Day 6: Travel Houston to Austin. Flight: "Flight Number: UA789, from Houston to Austin, Departure Time: 07:00, Arrival Time: 08:00". Breakfast: "On the plane". Attraction: "Zilker Metropolitan Park, Austin;". Lunch: "Franklin Barbecue". Dinner: "Bouldin Creek Cafe". Accommodation: "Hyatt Regency Austin". Day 7: Austin. Transportation: car rental. Breakfast: "Café No. 9". Attraction: "Austin Children's Museum, Austin;". Lunch: "Guero's Taco Shop". Dinner: "Franklin Barbecue again". Accommodation: same.

We should ensure child-friendly. Provide hotel names that are family-friendly.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
